content.stem: 一家金融机构的美国分行收到执法部门发出的传票，要求提供某客户账户活动的详细记录。该客户正因涉嫌洗钱活动而处于调查之中。与此同时，该机构还收到了另一家银行根据美国金融犯罪执法网络 314(b) 信息共享计划发出的信息共享请求，要求提供与该客户有关的交易详情。合规团队负责回应这两项请求。合规官在回应这些请求时应优先考虑哪些事项，同时确保满足所有法律和监管义务？

options.A: 在回复之前，将其他金融机构的信息共享请求告知客户并征得其同意
options.B: 咨询机构的法律顾问以确认传票的有效性，然后直接向执法部门作出回应，同时确保所有文件都得到妥善记录。
options.C: 首先回应 FinCEN 314(b) 请求，因为这允许与合作机构自愿共享信息
options.D: 立即向执法部门和另一家金融机构提供所请求的记录，以确保全面合作和透明度

content.stem_en: A financial institution's US branch receives a subpoena from law enforcement requesting detailed records of a customer's account activity. The customer is part of an ongoing investigation into a money laundering operation. At the same time, the institution has received a FinCEN 314(b) information-sharing request from another bank seeking details on transactions linked to the same customer. The compliance team is tasked with responding to both the subpoena and the FinCEN 314(b) request. What should the compliance officer prioritize in responding to these requests while ensuring that all legal and regulatory obligations are met?

options_en.A: Notify the customer of the information-sharing request from the other financial institution and seek their consent before responding
options_en.B: Consult the institution's legal counsel to validate the subpoena, then respond directly to law enforcement while ensuring all documentation is properly recorded
options_en.C: Respond to the FinCEN 314(b) request first, as it allows for voluntary information sharing with partner organizations
options_en.D: Provide the requested records to both law enforcement and the other financial institution immediately to ensure full cooperation and transparency
